{{Quote|There are fifty different species biomarkers coming off him, at least eight of which the computer can't even identify.|Calo Drusan, to [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] about Lord Odo|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
When [[Calo Drusan]] did a scan of the air outflow from [[Nuso Esva|Lord Odo's]] quarters to determine what Odo was, the '''biomarkers''' that were detected came from fifty different [[Species/Legends|species]], eight of which Drusan's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] could not identify.
